questions.stem: What is the primary function of a router in a computer network?

choices.A: To store and retrieve data from the network
choices.B: To connect multiple devices on a network and forward data packets between them
choices.C: To provide internet connectivity to the network
choices.D: To secure the network by filtering incoming and outgoing traffic

questions.solution: A router connects multiple devices on a network and forwards data packets between them, enabling communication between different networks and managing network traffic.
questions.explanation: Routers may contribute to security and provide internet connectivity, but their primary role is connecting devices and forwarding data.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing A (store and retrieve data) typically involves servers or storage devices. Choosing C (internet connectivity) can be misleading as routers can function without internet access, focusing on local network communication.

questions.stem: In a client-server architecture, what is the primary role of the client?

choices.A: To store and process data for multiple users
choices.B: To provide services to other devices by running applications
choices.C: To request resources or services from the server
choices.D: To manage network traffic between devices

questions.solution: In a client-server architecture, clients primarily request resources or services from the server. The server responds to these requests and provides the required data or service.
questions.explanation: Clients initiate communication while servers handle requested tasks. A and B describe server roles, and D is typically the function of a router.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing A (store and process data) may混淆 with database or application server roles. Choosing B (provide services) could be misinterpreted as clients request services from servers.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of using firewalls in computer networks?

choices.A: To increase network speed by optimizing data transmission
choices.B: To provide remote access to devices on the network
choices.C: To ensure secure communication by filtering unauthorized traffic
choices.D: To distribute network load and balance resources

questions.solution: Firewalls primarily filter unauthorized traffic, ensuring secure communication between trusted internal networks and untrusted external networks.
questions.explanation: Firewalls do not affect network speed, provide remote access, or distribute network load; these functions belong to other networking components.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing A (increase network speed) could be a misunderstanding of firewall functionality. Choosing B (remote access) might混淆 with virtual private networks (VPNs).

questions.stem: Which protocol is used for file transfers in computer networks?
questions.solution: FTP (File Transfer Protocol) enables uploading, downloading, and managing files between computers in computer networks.
questions.explanation: HTTP is for web content, SMTP is for email, and TCP is a transport layer protocol ensuring reliable data transmission.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing A (HTTP) could result from confusion with web browsing. Choosing C (SMTP) might happen when considering email attachments.

questions.stem: What technology allows devices to connect wirelessly to a computer network?
questions.solution: Wi-Fi technology enables wireless connections between devices and computer networks, providing convenience and flexibility without the need for physical cables.
questions.explanation: Ethernet is a wired networking standard, TCP/IP is a set of protocols for internetwork communication, and SSL/TLS is used for secure data transmission.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing A (Ethernet) could混淆 with traditional wired connections. Choosing C (TCP/IP) might happen when thinking about internet connectivity in general.

questions.stem: Which layer of the OSI (Open Systems Interconnection) model is responsible for routing data packets between networks?
questions.solution: The Network Layer in the OSI model routes data packets between networks, using addressing information and protocols like IP.
questions.explanation: The Application Layer deals with user applications, Transport Layer manages end-to-end communication, and Data Link Layer focuses on reliable transmission within a single network segment.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing A (Application Layer) could混淆 with high-level services. Choosing B (Transport Layer) might happen when thinking about error-free data transfer.

questions.stem: What is the primary function of a DNS (Domain Name System) server in computer networks?

choices.A: To translate IP addresses into human-readable domain names
choices.B: To provide internet connectivity to devices on the network
choices.C: To secure network traffic by encrypting data
choices.D: To manage and allocate network resources

questions.solution: DNS servers translate human-readable domain names into IP addresses, facilitating access to websites and online resources.
questions.explanation: DNS servers do not provide internet connectivity, secure traffic, or manage network resources. These functions are performed by other components in the network infrastructure.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing B (internet connectivity) could混淆 with routers or modems. Choosing C (secure traffic) might happen when thinking about protocols like HTTPS.
